headline: As of 2026-10-31: 50,254,140 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 50,254,140 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,050,671), California (5,094,898), Florida (4,725,732).
